text:
Maya Bennett

Commercial Bread Baker

f01@example.com | Hamilton, Ontario

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Commercial baker with a Baking and Pastry diploma and experience in team-based bread production, including sourdough and enriched doughs.

CORE SKILLS

Sourdough fermentation | Ingredient scaling | Allergen separation | Batch records

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Commercial Baker - Example Millhouse Bread | 2022 – 2026

Worked in a four-person bakery team producing approximately 240 loaves per morning shift; this was the total team output.
Mixed sourdough and enriched doughs and adjusted proofing times using dough temperature and the production schedule.
Recorded allergen changeovers and separated nut-containing products during packing.

Bakery Assistant - Example Corner Oven | 2020 – 2022

Scaled ingredients, shaped rolls and prepared the ovens under the head baker’s direction.
Logged surplus bread for the daily donation collection.
EDUCATION

Baking and Pastry diploma

Example Culinary College | 2020
